name: vns-umbraco-property-editors
description: Multi-language textbox property editor for Umbraco 17, shipped as the NuGet package VNS.MultiLanguageTextbox.
author: Martin H. Schläger

scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
scripts.version:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
scripts.pack: npm run build && dotnet pack nuget/VNS.MultiLanguageTextbox.csproj -c Release -o nuget/artifacts
